purpose: Per CEO R300 P1: 'Fill the vacancy only from the existing candidate universe. Search existing WATCH/DISCOVERED/COMMERCIAL_FRAMED candidates. Find the strongest already-existing candidate that can plausibly occupy slot 15.'
constitutional_basis: Article X (canonical state). Article XXVIII (no silent semantic promotion — portfolio admission is not validation).

vacancy_context.rule: Fill from EXISTING candidates only. No new invention generation.

existing_unpromoted_candidates.name: UWB Real-Time Intracranial Position Mapper
existing_unpromoted_candidates.r270_assessment: MODERATE — novel sensing modality. BUT: major physics risk (UWB through skull). May be impossible.
existing_unpromoted_candidates.mechanism: Ultra-wideband radar through skull to map ventricular anatomy and catheter position in real-time
existing_unpromoted_candidates.fatal_blocker_check: MAJOR PHYSICS RISK — UWB through skull may be physically impossible (skull attenuates RF severely). This IS a known fatal blocker.

admission_gate.first_evidence_action: physics feasibility of UWB through skull

existing_unpromoted_candidates.verdict: REJECTED — known fatal blocker (physics risk of UWB through skull)

existing_unpromoted_candidates.name: Biohybrid Living Endothelial Monolayer Interface
existing_unpromoted_candidates.r270_assessment: MODERATE — living self-repairing surface. BUT: tissue-engineered vascular implants exist. Needs deep collision.
existing_unpromoted_candidates.mechanism: Living endothelial cell monolayer on implant surface that self-repairs damage and prevents thrombosis/biofilm
existing_unpromoted_candidates.fatal_blocker_check: No known fatal blocker. Tissue-engineered surfaces exist (adjacent art) but living IMPLANT monolayer is novel application.

admission_gate.first_evidence_action: literature review of living cell coatings on implants

existing_unpromoted_candidates.market: Cardiovascular + Orthopedics (cross-market — living surface applies to stents, heart valves, joint replacements)
existing_unpromoted_candidates.buyer_pain: Thrombosis on stents/valves. Biofilm on joint replacements. Both require anticoagulants/antibiotics with side effects.
existing_unpromoted_candidates.tev_estimate: P_tech=0.20 (living cell coating on chronic implant is novel and hard) × P_buyer=0.55 (cross-market, many buyers) × $275K − $10K = $19,750
existing_unpromoted_candidates.verdict: CANDIDATE FOR PROMOTION — passes admission gate. Cross-market (cardio + ortho). Living surface is a platform technology.

existing_unpromoted_candidates.name: Pressure-Gradient Autonomous Catheter Navigation
existing_unpromoted_candidates.r270_assessment: WEAKER — autonomous navigation is qualitatively different. BUT: Gate P reveals control law (gradient-following) is standard.
existing_unpromoted_candidates.mechanism: Catheter that autonomously navigates to optimal position using pressure gradient sensing
existing_unpromoted_candidates.fatal_blocker_check: Gate P revealed control law = standard gradient-following. Not a fatal blocker but weak differentiation.
existing_unpromoted_candidates.verdict: WEAK CANDIDATE — passes admission gate but weak differentiation (standard gradient-following)

existing_unpromoted_candidates.name: Through-Skull NIR Photovoltaic with Adaptive Therapeutic Release
existing_unpromoted_candidates.r270_assessment: MODERATE — zero-battery is qualitatively different. BUT: through-skin photovoltaic is active research at MIT/Stanford. Needs deep collision.
existing_unpromoted_candidates.mechanism: Near-infrared light through skin/skull powers implantable photovoltaic cell for sensing + drug release
existing_unpromoted_candidates.fatal_blocker_check: No known fatal blocker. Through-skin photovoltaic is active research (MIT/Stanford). NIR penetration depth is the key question.

admission_gate.first_evidence_action: compute NIR penetration depth through scalp/skull at implantable PV wavelengths

existing_unpromoted_candidates.market: Neuro + Cardiovascular + Drug Delivery (cross-market — zero-battery implantable is universal)
existing_unpromoted_candidates.buyer_pain: Battery replacement surgery. Same pain as P-08/P-15 but different energy source (NIR instead of mechanical harvesting).
existing_unpromoted_candidates.tev_estimate: P_tech=0.25 (NIR PV through scalp is plausible, active research) × P_buyer=0.50 (universal implant pain) × $275K − $5K = $29,125
existing_unpromoted_candidates.verdict: STRONGER CANDIDATE — passes admission gate. NIR photovoltaic is an alternative to mechanical harvesting (P-15) with different physics. Active research at MIT/Stanford validates the approach.

existing_unpromoted_candidates.name: Adaptive Synthetic Glycan Immune-Tolerance Surface
existing_unpromoted_candidates.r270_assessment: WEAKER — SC-05's smarter sibling. More specific but glycan/IL-10 still unspecified. Concept until molecules designed.
existing_unpromoted_candidates.mechanism: Synthetic glycan coating that induces local immune tolerance, preventing foreign-body reaction and fibrosis around implant
existing_unpromoted_candidates.fatal_blocker_check: Glycan/IL-10 molecules unspecified. Similar to P-09 (molecule unspecified). Not a fatal blocker but high risk.

admission_gate.first_evidence_action: literature review of glycan immune-tolerance coatings

existing_unpromoted_candidates.verdict: MODERATE CANDIDATE — passes admission gate but molecule unspecified (similar risk profile to P-09)

promotion_decision.name: Through-Skull NIR Photovoltaic with Adaptive Therapeutic Release
promotion_decision.rationale: SC-I passes the admission gate with the STRONGEST combination of: (1) no known fatal blocker, (2) cross-market applicability (neuro + cardio + drug delivery), (3) active research validation (MIT/Stanford working on through-skin PV), (4) addresses the same universal pain as P-08/P-15 (battery elimination) but with a DIFFERENT physics (NIR photovoltaic vs mechanical harvesting), (5) highest TEV estimate among unpromoted candidates ($29,125).
promotion_decision.first_evidence_action: Compute NIR penetration depth through scalp/skull at implantable PV wavelengths (850-940 nm). Compare to published MIT/Stanford through-skin PV results. Cost: $0-5K (computational/literature).
promotion_decision.admission_note: This is a PORTFOLIO ADMISSION, not a validation. P-16 is commercially framed (mechanism + market + buyers + first evidence action). It has NOT been validated. P_tech = 0.25 (MODELLED). TEV = $29,125 (MODELLED EV).

portfolio_after_promotion.new_candidate: P-16 (promoted from SC-I, existing R270 candidate — NOT newly invented)
portfolio_after_promotion.rule_satisfied: Vacancy filled from EXISTING candidate universe. No new invention generated. SC-I was identified in R270 and evaluated through the 15-gate protocol. It was not promoted to the original 15-package portfolio in R275 but remained in the existing candidate universe.
